Ready to kickstart your tech career near Eindhoven? Join Prodrive Technologies in Son en Breugel as a Assembly Technician! No experience? No problem, if you're accurate, speak English, and love working with your hands, we’ll train you to build impressive mechatronic systems. Enjoy free weekends with a Monday-to-Friday 2-shift schedule, a sweet monthly salary between €3,310 - €4,110 (including shift allowance), free daily lunch and dinner, free gym access, and the freedom to blast your favorite tunes on your headphones while you work. Sound like your kind of job? Apply today!

What we offer
- Salary up to €4110 incl. shift allowance
- No experience needed, full training provided!
- Weekends completely free
- Free lunch & dinner during your shifts
- Free on-site gym access at Prodrive
- Listen to your own music while working

Who you are
As our Assembly Technician it's important that you bring the following things with you:

- You are fluent in English
- You can work in Son en Breugel (near Science Park Eindhoven)
- You are available full-time in 2 shifts (06:00–14:15 / 14:15–23:00)

What will you do
Get ready to build the tech of tomorrow! In this role, you will assemble top-tier mechatronic modules and hook up detailed wiring using clear technical drawings. Armed with precision tools like torque wrenches, you'll run quick quality checks on your work to keep standards sky-high. You'll team up with your colleagues in a clean, safe workspace, making sure every single build leaves the floor in perfect shape.

Where will you work
You’ll be joining Prodrive Technologies, a leading high-tech company based in Son en Breugel, right next to Eindhoven (near Science Park). Prodrive builds cutting-edge electronics and smart systems for top global brands. Inside their modern, clean, and high-tech facility, you'll work alongside friendly colleagues in a great atmosphere, complete with free daily lunch and dinner, an on-site gym, and the freedom to listen to your favorite music w

Working via Staffice at our client in Hoofddorp, you contribute directly to managing peak order volumes. Your shift begins at 07:00 with picking goods, verifying order details, and staging shipments. Because this contract covers the Black Friday rush, standard working hours run from 07:00 to 15:30, but daily operational demands require flexibility to stay until 19:00.
 Tasks
  -  Picking warehouse orders accurately
 
 -  Quality-checking and packing items for dispatch
 
 -  Working extended shifts until 19:00 based on open workload
 
 -  Taking on weekend shifts during peak demand
 
 -  Helping across various warehouse departments as needed
 
 -  Maintaining clean and organized picking locations
 
 
 We are looking for
  -  Proven background in order picking
 
 -  Fluency in English
 
 -  Full availability between October 30 and December 7
 
 -  High flexibility regarding working hours and weekend availability
 
 -  Proactive and reliable work ethic
 
 
 We offer
  -  Gross hourly salary of €16.40
 
 -  Travel cost reimbursement
 
 -  Standard 8% holiday pay plus statutory holiday days
 
 -  Payout on a weekly basis via Staffice
 
 -  Energy bars and refreshments provided during peak shifts
 
 -  Direct advice and guidance from your Staffice advisor
 
 -  Een leuke werksfeer is gegarandeerd.
 
 
 Why Staffice?
  -  Fast onboarding process with trusted clients
 
 -  Transparent and accurate weekly payroll
 
 -  Personal care and active job matching
 
 -  Next-step options for future temporary positions
 
 
 This job opening in Hoofddorp is also interesting if you live in Schiphol, Nieuw-Vennep, Haarlemmermeer, or Amsterdam. We kijken naar jouw skills en helpen bij het behalen van certificaten als dat nodig is.
 Are you still enthusiastic about this vacancy in logistics? Apply now and we will contact you shortly. Do you have questions? Feel free to call us at 085-0600565.

Ready for a new challenge, in possession of a reach truck certificate and you are not averse to working a little hard? Are we describing you briefly here? Then the position of reachtruck driver in Helmond might be perfect job for you! In addition to a pleasant group of colleagues, you can count on a gross salary of €17.88 per hour (this includes 8.75% shift allowance) excellent secondary employment conditions. Read on and apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for several reach truck drivers for a company in Helmond.

As a reach truck driver, you are responsible for picking all orders. You operate the reach truck to navigate to the correct storage locations, collect the required number of products, and transport them to the next station where your colleagues handle the next steps in the order process.

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of  €17.88 per hour (this includes 8.75% shift allowance)
    
- Reimbursement of travel costs (vanaf vijf kilometer)
    
- Overtime allowances are as follows: a 150% rate applies to hours worked beyond 8 hours per day, and a 175% rate applies to work performed on Saturdays. Pension accrual is arranged via Manpower.
    
- Free access to E-learning platform Manpower Academy 
    
- Full-time/ job of 40 hours a week 
    
- Temporary employment contract with Manpower

    - In possession of a valid reach truck certificate
    
- At least one year of work experience as a reach truck driver, warehouse employee, order picker or similar
    
- A good command of the Dutch language is required so that you can have basic conversations and maintain email contact.
    
- Knowledge of the English language due to communication with colleagues and customers

Are you the new reach truck driver that our client is looking for? Then don't hesitate and apply today! Manpower will contact you within two working days.

We're seeking enthusiastic individuals to help manage our international distribution center, serving stores and customers across multiple European countries. Your role in our team As a Logistics Employee at Decathlon, you'll be part of a dedicated team responsible for ensuring smooth operations in our state-of-the-art facility. As a warehouse worker, you keep everything running smoothly:

- Picking orders like clothing and shoes
- Packing items carefully and preparing them for shipment
- Helping to keep stock organized

You’ll work full-time in a 2-shift system (morning and afternoon). The schedule is clear and planned in advance, so you always know what to expect.

- You can speak and read English
- You have your own transport to GXO Heerlen
- You’re available fulltime in 2 shifts
- Experience in logistics is nice, but not required (GXO teach you everything)

As a warehouse employee in Veghel, you work full-time from 11:30 AM to 8:00 PM. You ensure that medicines and medical supplies leave the warehouse quickly and correctly. You work accurately because every detail matters. This job is perfect for you if you like to take responsibility and want to make a difference in healthcare.
On a typical day, you pick orders using a hand scanner. You check the orders for accuracy and prepare everything for shipment. You make sure the right products reach pharmacies and healthcare institutions on time. You work together with colleagues in the warehouse but can also work independently.
Are you motivated and do you like to get to work? Then we are looking for you! With your effort, you really make a difference for many people. Apply today and become part of a professional team in an important sector! 🚀

- You already bring logistic experience with you
- You speak and write English
- You work accurately and responsibly
- You are motivated and have a positive attitude
- You can work well both in a team and independently

Logistics workers in Parkstad Limburg, this is your chance to join Boston Scientific in Kerkrade and make a real difference every day! At Boston Scientific, you’ll enjoy a great team atmosphere and plenty of chances to grow and develop your skills. You’ll earn a good salary of €15.25 per hour, and that is even without the additional 7.5% shift allowance included. Plus, you can benefit from great perks like pension plans and a healthy work environment. If you live in Parkstad Limburg and want a job with purpose and good rewards, don’t wait! Apply now and start your new adventure with Boston Scientific!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for full-time Inbound logistics employees for Boston Scientific Kerkrade in Parkstad Limburg.

Every day, you kick off with your team and happily sort the incoming deliveries. You carefully register all items in the system to keep everything organized. Then, you move the goods to their right spots in the warehouse. Your work keeps everything running smoothly!

What’s in it for you

✔️ Gross salary of €15.25 per hour (this is excluding the shift work allowance of 7.5%)

✔️ Performance based annual salary increase, a bonus for achieving team KPI's (3% of gross annual salary) and a 13th month salary

✔️ Reimbursement of travel expenses of €0.21 per kilometer

✔️ Pension accrual via Manpower

✔️ Opportunity to exercise for free (for example with Zumba, spinning or yoga classes) and even massages

✔️ Shift work allowance of 7.5%

✔️ Excellent growth and development opportunities within Boston Scientific

✔️ Free online training opportunities at e-learning platform Manpower Academy

✔️ Positive and supportive work culture

✔️ Every day: extra free fresh fruit on site

    - Own transport (car, moped, scooter or bicycle) to get to the work location
    
- Able to produce a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
    
- Physically able to move pallets with the aid of a (hand) pallet truck and to place boxes on shelves
    
- Command of the English

Do you enjoy being active, do you work accurately, and do you appreciate variety in your work? We are looking for enthusiastic part-time warehouse employees for our warehouse in Ede. You will work in a 2-shift system, rotating weekly between a morning and evening shift.
As a warehouse employee, you ensure that all orders are correct, complete, and ready for shipment on time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the logistics process runs smoothly.

What will you be doing?
You start your workday in the warehouse by picking orders. Using a scanner and headset, you know exactly which products to collect. You carefully check the correct items and quantities. When an order is complete, you ensure that it is packed neatly and safely. You select the right packaging material, apply the correct labels, and perform a final check before the order is shipped. In short: you ensure that every order reaches the customer correctly and on time.

Working hours
You work in a 2-shift system and rotate shifts every week:

-  Morning shift: 07:00 – 16:00
- Evening shift: 16:00 – 00:00

In addition, you are willing to work one Saturday every four weeks from 08:00 – 16:00.

- You are available for at least 2 working days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift system
- You are a real team player
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are physically capable of performing active, standing work
- Do you need a work permit? We are happy to help you with the application!

Did you know that dogs also could dream? 🐶 And I hear you thinking right now, about what?! Well, about the nice pet food you are going to produce at Saturn Petcare in Hattem. 🏭 You can start as a production employee in 3 shifts. 🔄 You will be getting a nice salary that goes up as high as €19,11. 💰 Got your attention already? Read through the vacancy quickly! 🚀

For this function you will need your own housing in The Netherlands. 🏠

What we offer
- Nice starting salary of € 17,58 💵
- Travel compensation of €0,23 per kilometer 🚗
- Shift allowances up to 25% 🤑
- Opportunities to grow to different departments
- Part-time and full-time possibilities !
- Work with nice colleagues!

Who you are
Do you love to roll up your sleeves and get to work?  And do you enjoy production work? Perfect! ✨ This is what we need:

- You are fluent in Dutch or English;
- You are at least 18 years old;
- You are at least 1.65 meters tall;
- You have your own transportation to get to Saturn Petcare in Hattem;
- You are available at least 1 day per week;
- You are flexible regarding all work shifts;
- You are looking for a long-term job.

What will you do
Do you have your working shoes ready? 👟 Your shift is about to start! 🕒 When you work as a production employee at Saturn, there are a few options for you to start. For example you can work at the meat department, this is where the meat gets prepared to be the delicious pet food! 🥩 Or you could work at the filling line. You are checking the machines that put the meals into the packages. 🥫 An empty package isn’t going to sell, so as a production employee you can also stand at the packaging line. 📦 Here you make sure that the labels are put on accordingly and also that the pallets are piled up correctly. 🏗️ You’ll be working in three shifts from Monday to Friday. 🔄 Your working times are: 07:00-15:00, 15:00-23:00, 23:00-07:00! 🚀

You earn €15.25 per hour (excluding 7.5% shift allowance), build up a pension, and have a chance at a permanent contract. You work in a nice atmosphere, help in healthcare, and can join free sports activities. Apply quickly and bring your energy!

Manpower employment gency is looking for multiple all-round logistics employees for Boston Scientific in Kerkrade, both Inbound and Outbound.

This way, you help everything run smoothly and orders are ready on time for the customer.
